text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Australia, Jan 6 - COAL, Queensland - Abbot Point - berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 25/1/ no delays. Hay Point - one vessel loading, 1 waiting, 11 vessels due by 25/1/ no delays. Dalrymple bay - one vessel loading, 14 vessels due by 19/1, no delays. Adstone - one vessel loading, 2 awaiting cargo, 1 waiting. 12 vessels due by 28/1, 1-2 days delay. Brisbane - four vessels due by 21/1, no delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle - Kooragang 2 vessels loading, 7 waiting, 14 due by 22/1, 5-6 days delay. Dyke 4+5 1 vessel awaiting cargo, 2 vessels loading, 3 waiting, 16 due by 19/1, 3-4 days delay. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 19 due by 20/1, 2-3 days delay.

IRON ORE, Western Australia - Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored. E.I. Island 1 vessel loading, 4 anchored. Dampier lineup 13 vessels due by 13/1, berthing delays for one of the vessels. Port Walcott - eight vessels due by 20/1. All vessels subject to movement of Cyclone Rachel, at 0900 hours 6/1 located within 30 km. of lat. 17.95, long 120.8 E and moving SW at 11 km/hr. This may cause port closures at Dampier and Port Walcott in the next 24 hours. Port Hedland - closed since 0800 hours 6/1 for all inbound movement until further notice due to Cyclone Rachel. Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) berth a 1 vessel anchored, 1 due 7/1, berth b 1 vessel loading, 2 anchored, 1 due 7/1, 8 other vessels due with no eta. Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) 1 vessel anchored, 2 vessels due.
Jan 8 - GRAIN, Queensland - Mackay - no vessels due. Gladstone - one vessel loading wheat. Brisbane - one vessel loading wheat, 2 wheat in port, 4 wheat vessels due 16/12.

New South Wales - Newcastle - one wheat vessel in port, 4 due by 21/1. Sydney - no further grain loading expected. Port Kembla - six vessels due. Victoria - Geelong - one barley vessel in port, 7 vessels due by 28/1. Portland - seven due by 1/2.

South Australia - Port Pirie - three wheat vessels due by 28/1. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel in port, 2 due by 22/1. Thevenard - one wheat vessel due 25/1. Port Lincoln - one wheat vessel in port, 8 vessels due by 31/1. Wallaroo six vessels due by 3/2. Ardrossan - no vessels due. Port Giles - five wheat vessels due by 6/2.

Western Australia - Geraldton - four vessels in port, 3 due by 13/1. Kwinana - two wheat vessels in port, 16 vessels due (mostly wheat). Albany - one vessel loading wheat, 3 vessels in port, 5 vessels due by 23/1. Esperance - one vessel loading wheat, 2 vessels in port, 4 vessels due by 20/1.
